id.description: Stable candidate id, unique in the registry.

license.description: SPDX id where known, otherwise the literal upstream expression.

channel.description: How the adapter acquires the tool. Mirrors the adapter classes in docs/reference/plugin-model.md.

install.description: Concrete install spec (pip requirement, apt package, image ref, release URL).

entry_point.description: CLI binary or python entry point the adapter invokes.

kind.description: bridge = thin adapter over an external pack; adapter = direct tool; suite = tool family; platform = runtime target; reference = context only, never executed.

linkage.description: How Axiom links the tool. Copyleft tools MUST be subprocess.

plugin_point.description: Axiom extension point this candidate plugs into (tools/<id>, skills/<id>, agents/<id>, domains/<id>, platforms/<id>, packages/<pkg>).

categories.description: Capability buckets used for grouping in the catalogue doc.

benefit.description: One-line statement of the concrete benefit to an AxiomEmbedded project.

rejected_reason.description: Why a candidate is rejected (licence, dead project, not headless, unverifiable).
